gloss: an ingredient of the holy incense
definition: שְׁחֵ֫לֶת noun feminine an ingredient of the holy incense , + נָטָף , חֶלְבְּנָה , Exod 30:34 ᵐ5 ᵑ9 ὄνυξ , onyx (whence AV onycha ), i.e. unguis odoratus , the operculum , or closing-flap, of certain molluscs, with pungent odour whenburnt, see Thes 1388 f. Di Shipley- Cook Ency. Bib. ONYCHA ; so most; KG Jacob ZMG xliii (1889), 354 proposes amber .
